jobs.title: Services Specialist - Wireline
jobs.description: Services Specialist - Wireline Would you like the opportunity to learn cutting-edge technology? Do you enjoy being part of a successful team? Join our Wireline Team! We are the leader in well construction and production. Our innovative physical and digital solutions improve efficiency, production and maximize reservoir value. Partner with the best As a Services Specialist - Wireline , you will be responsible for: Executing wireline operations in line with technical program, safety standards (HSE) and customer requirements Ensuring tools are fit-for-job before deploymen and equipment is properly maintained and handed over after operations Performing tool preparation, assembly, and function testing, and Real-time operational support during jobs Supporting equipment readiness through proper usage and car maintenance team by identifying issues early Maintaining accurate job reports and equipment status updates ​ Fuel your passion To be successful in this role you will: Have a minimum of 3-6 years of experience in wireline field operations (open hole / cased hole / Sondex tools) and running and deploying downhole tools at wellsite. Have basic maintenance, troubleshooting, and equipment repair experience Have hands-on Sondex tool experience (highly desirable / preferred) Have a Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related technical discipline. Be familiar with Job Center / field reporting systems and have basic SAP exposure (equipment tracking, job documentation – optional) Be proficient in reporting job activities and tool status and using field digital acquisition systems Have strong field discipline and safety mindset Have the ability to work under pressure in remote/rig environments Be a team player with good communication at wellsite Have a practical, hands-on problem-solving attitude Work in a way that works for you We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. Working with us Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. Working for you Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect: · Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities Comprehensive private medical care options Safety net of life insurance and disability programs Tailored financial programs Additional elected or voluntary benefits The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Services Experienced Professional - On Site Services

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Process
jobs.description: Job Title: Process / Commissioning Engineer – Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) & Infrastructure Job Summary The Process / Commissioning Engineer will work under the supervision of the Resident Engineer and Project Manager as part of the construction supervision team on major STP, pumping station, and wastewater infrastructure projects in Dubai. The role focuses on the process, testing, and commissioning aspects of mechanical, electrical, and ICA (Instrumentation, Control, and Automation) systems, ensuring compliance with design requirements, performance specifications, and local authority standards. The successful candidate will oversee and coordinate all commissioning activities to ensure the successful start-up and handover of the facility. Job Duties Supervise process and commissioning activities for STPs, pumping stations, and associated infrastructure, including process systems, mechanical equipment, electrical works (MV/LV), and ICA systems. Oversee installation, testing, and commissioning of SCADA systems, PLCs, control panels, field instrumentation, and telemetry systems. Verify functional testing, performance testing, and plant start-up in line with contractual and operational requirements. Review and comment on contractor submissions, including shop drawings, commissioning plans, method statements, ITPs, O&M manuals, and FAT/SAT reports. Coordinate and witness factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) for key process and ICA equipment. Ensure compliance with Dubai Municipality, DEWA, and other applicable authority standards for process, electrical, and ICA systems. Work closely with the contractor to develop and implement commissioning schedules, ensuring integration between civil, mechanical, electrical, and process disciplines. Review process control philosophies, P&IDs, and operating sequences to ensure correct system configuration and functionality. Lead troubleshooting during pre-commissioning and commissioning stages, recommending corrective measures as required. Monitor progress of commissioning activities, provide status updates to the Resident Engineer/Project Manager, and highlight any risks or delays. Review and verify as-built documentation, including commissioning records and performance test results. Mentor and guide junior engineers and inspectors in process and commissioning supervision. Maintain strong liaison with the client, contractor, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth coordination and successful project delivery. Qualifications Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Control Systems from a recognized university. Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in the design, construction, and commissioning of STPs, rising mains, pumping stations, and wastewater infrastructure. Proven experience in process operations, testing, and commissioning of treatment plant equipment and ICA systems. Preferred Qualifications: Strong knowledge of STP process design, pumping systems, and water/wastewater treatment technologies. Familiarity with SCADA integration, PLC programming principles, and instrumentation calibration. Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental (HSE) requirements for commissioning works. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and scheduling software (Primavera preferred). Proven leadership skills with the ability to make sound engineering decisions under pressure.

jobs.title: Administration Manager
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, UAE, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: The Administration Manager is responsible for the overall management of the project's administrative functions, including document control, office administration, records and correspondence management, and related support services. The role ensures that project information and administrative processes are managed accurately, efficiently and in full compliance with company and project procedures, providing reliable administrative support to the wider project team. Key Responsibilities Document Control Manage the receipt, registration, distribution, tracking and archival of project documents in accordance with the Document Control Procedure. Receive, register, code and distribute project documents — including drawings, specifications, correspondence, submittals, RFIs and transmittals — to the relevant internal teams and external parties. Maintain and administer the project's electronic document management system (EDMS) together with hard-copy records and archives. Track document status, revisions and transmittals, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround of approvals and responses. Ensure compliance with the project's document numbering, naming, classification and retention rules across all disciplines, contractors and subcontractors. Support internal and external audits related to document control, and prepare document control status reports for project leadership. Coordinate document control interfaces with the client, consultants, contractors and subcontractors, including their respective document control teams. Office & Facilities Administration Oversee day-to-day office administration, including facilities, office supplies, equipment, courier/mail services and general upkeep of the project office(s). Manage office leases, vendor contracts and service providers for administrative and facilities services, ensuring service quality and value for money. Coordinate travel, accommodation, visa processing and government/PRO liaison arrangements for project staff and visitors. Organize and support internal meetings, workshops and project events, including logistics, minutes and follow-up on action items. Records, Correspondence & Reporting Manage the project's incoming and outgoing correspondence, ensuring proper logging, distribution and timely response. Maintain organized filing and archival systems, both physical and electronic, in line with company and project retention policies. Prepare and maintain administrative reports, registers and dashboards (e.g., correspondence logs, document control KPIs) for project leadership. Team & Process Management Supervise and manage the performance of document controllers, office administrators and other administrative support staff. Develop, implement and continuously improve administration and document control procedures, templates and workflows in line with company standards. Support the recruitment, onboarding and training of administrative and document control staff as required. Manage the administration function's budget and resourcing, and liaise with the Project Director/Manager and other department heads on administrative matters affecting the project. Ensure the confidentiality, security and integrity of sensitive project information and records at all times. Minimum Experience The following are the mandatory minimum requirements for this position: Minimum of ten (10) years’ experience in document control and/or project administration, including experience managing a document control function on a major project. Proficiency in electronic document management systems (EDMS) such as Aconex, ProjectWise or similar platforms. Middle East / UAE experience is highly advantageous. Rail or major infrastructure project experience is preferable. A university degree

jobs.title: Surveyor - Civil (RAIL)
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, UAE, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: The Surveyor – Civil is responsible for providing setting-out, control and as-built survey support to the civil works construction team, ensuring that works are constructed in the correct position, alignment and level in accordance with approved drawings and design data. The role provides continuous survey support throughout construction, from establishing site control through to as-built verification and handover records. Key Responsibilities Setting-Out & Survey Control Establish and maintain survey control points, benchmarks and reference grids across the site and alignment. Set out (stake) alignments, levels, gridlines and reference points for earthworks, structures, drainage, depot and online buildings from approved drawings and design data. Carry out routine and specialized surveys — topographic, cross-section and volume/quantity surveys — to support construction planning and progress measurement. Verify and check the setting-out of contractor survey teams prior to construction of key elements. As-Built Verification & Monitoring Carry out as-built surveys to verify that constructed works conform to approved design and specified tolerances. Prepare and issue as-built drawings and survey records to support QA/QC verification and handover documentation. Support monitoring surveys — such as settlement, deformation and alignment checks — for structures, earthworks and track-related works. Data Management & Reporting Process and manage survey data using relevant software (e.g., AutoCAD Civil 3D or equivalent) and maintain accurate coordinate registers. Maintain accurate survey records, field books, calculation sheets and instrument logs. Prepare survey reports and progress/quantity records to support project management, QA/QC and commercial teams. Coordination & Compliance Liaise with site engineers, QA/QC and contractor survey teams to coordinate setting-out, verification and monitoring activities. Ensure all survey work complies with project specifications, coordinate systems/datums and applicable standards. Maintain, calibrate and care for survey instruments and equipment, reporting any defects or calibration issues promptly. Support the investigation and resolution of survey-related queries, discrepancies and non-conformances. Minimum Qualifications & Experience Minimum of five (5) to eight (8) years’ construction/site surveying experience, including setting-out and as-built survey work. Proficiency with survey instruments (total station, GNSS/GPS, levels) and survey/CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD Civil 3D). Middle East / UAE experience is highly advantageous. Rail or major infrastructure project experience is preferable. Degree in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering or a related field, or demonstrated equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Inspector - QA/QC (RAIL)
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, UAE, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: The QA/QC Inspector (Rail) is responsible for carrying out site inspection and surveillance of civil works to verify compliance with approved designs, specifications and quality requirements. The role ensures that materials and workmanship meet project and contractual quality standards prior to acceptance, and that non-conformances are identified, recorded and resolved in a timely and well-documented manner. Key Responsibilities Site Inspection & Surveillance Conduct daily inspections of civil works, including earthworks, concrete, structures, drainage and utilities. Carry out inspection and surveillance of civil works in accordance with approved Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), method statements and applicable hold/witness points. Verify materials and workmanship against approved drawings, specifications, project standards and applicable codes. Attend and witness testing activities (e.g., concrete cube testing, compaction/density testing, welding inspection) and verify results against acceptance criteria. Inspect earthworks (subgrade, embankment, compaction), concrete works (formwork, reinforcement, pours, curing), structures (bridges, culverts, retaining walls, buildings), drainage and utility works. Non-Conformances & Quality Records Raise and track non-conformance reports (NCRs) for work or materials that do not meet approved requirements, following through to close-out. Complete inspection checklists, daily quality reports and inspection request (IR) records for all inspected activities. Maintain accurate and complete quality records, photographs and supporting documentation for each inspection. Support the preparation of quality documentation and test/inspection packages for handover and close-out. Coordination & Compliance Liaise with contractor quality teams to coordinate inspection requests, hold/witness points and inspection scheduling. Coordinate with the design/engineering team on non-conformances, technical queries and any deviations requiring clarification or approval. Support internal and external quality audits and inspections, providing records and evidence as required. Report inspection findings, quality trends and recurring issues to the QA/QC Manager, escalating significant quality concerns promptly. Ensure compliance with the project Quality Management Plan, applicable codes/standards and contractual quality requirements at all times. Promote a quality-first culture on site and support contractor personnel in understanding and meeting quality requirements. Minimum Qualifications & Experience The following are the mandatory minimum requirements for this position: Minimum of five (5) years’ inspection or site supervision experience. Knowledge of construction quality procedures. Middle East / UAE experience is highly advantageous. Rail experience is preferable. University degree, or demonstrated equivalent experience in civil engineering / inspection.

Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

About the role

We're looking for an Operations Lead - Shops to own the performance of our Shops marketplace across the UAE and Jordan. This is a purely marketplace mandate so your world is merchant partners, their in-store picking teams, and the KPIs that determine a delightful customer experience. You'll sit at the intersection of merchant operations, strategic planning, and hands-on picking excellence.

What you'll do

  • Merchant Operations Performance. Own the end-to-end performance scorecard for merchant partners across UAE & JOR - order acceptance rate, prep time, order accuracy, cancellation rate, and customer contact rate and run the cadence that holds merchants accountable to it.

  • Unit Economics. Build and defend the Last-Mile Unit Economics of every merchant cohort, working with Captain Operations to balance delivery cost, speed, and Captain earnings.
  • Business Reviews. Run quarterly and monthly business reviews with top merchant accounts, using cohort-level data (e.g., "Based on recent cohorts in Abu Dhabi and Amman...") to justify investment or intervention.
  • Peak Planning. Lead peak-season readiness planning for Ramadan and Dubai Shopping Festival - demand forecasting, merchant capacity planning, and picking-team surge staffing.
  • Team & Cross-Functional Leadership. Manage a team of Operations Specialists/Leads across both markets, and act as the connective tissue between central functions.

What you'll need

  • 3-5 years in operations, quick-commerce, last-mile logistics, or retail/e-commerce marketplace roles, with at least 2 years managing teams and external partners directly.
  • Experience managing frontline or in-store operations (picking, warehousing, fulfillment) - you've been on the floor, not just in the dashboard.

jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the role

This role leads the growth function for Careem Food in Dubai and, by extension, UAE. The Manager owns bottom-up planning, tracks performance against plan, designs and program manages growth initiatives, and ensures cross-functional alignment. This person is the primary bridge between the growth team and the commercial organisation, with direct accountability for ensuring Food hits its revenue targets in the market.

What you’ll do

Growth Planning & Bottom-Up Strategy

    • Own the bottom-up growth plan for Dubai/UAE – translating market opportunity into measurable targets across MAUs, OPU, ARPU, and revenue.
    • Build and maintain the quarterly and annual growth roadmap, ensuring tight alignment with organisational revenue goals.

Performance Tracking & Reporting

    • Own the performance rhythm for Dubai/UAE: weekly/monthly plan vs. actuals reviews, funnel health checks, and initiative-level tracking.
    • Build and maintain dashboards that surface the health of key growth metrics across the customer funnel.
    • Proactively diagnose gaps vs. plan, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions at pace.

Commercial Partnership & Revenue Accountability

    • Act as the primary growth point of contact for the Food commercial team – ensuring growth and commercial plans are tightly integrated.
    • Co-own revenue target delivery with the commercial team; design offers, incentives, and promotions that balance growth outcomes with unit economics.

Initiative Design & Execution

    • Design growth initiatives end-to-end across user acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetisation.
    • Lead A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to iterate and optimize initiatives across channels.

Program Management

    • Own the execution cadence for the Dubai/UAE growth portfolio: scoping, resourcing, launch timelines, and post-launch measurement.
    • Ensure initiatives are delivered on time with clear owners, milestones, and success metrics.
    • Manage cross-team dependencies and proactively escalate blockers to leadership.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management

    • Align Product, Engineering, Operations, and Marketing around the Dubai/UAE growth agenda.
    • Communicate growth performance and strategy clearly to senior stakeholders and leadership.
